operations.preconditions: Optional city slot in 0..255; all i32 retained mood counters. Supplied-child subsystem boundary; no city record or full C03 pipeline is installed.
partialEffects: Full selection precedes child entry; every completed provider output and nested call remains visible on stop.
operations.aliasing: One shared workspace for parent and all nested entries. The request keeps its selected city separately from live workspaceCity.
operations.eventIdentity: Call enter/return: <call>/enter or /return. Provider: <call>/pipeline/request or /return. Actions: <call>/action/<escaped-id>. Escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1. Final root/exit, or root/prefix then root/stop. See tools/conformance_script.py for typed payload validation.
operations.eventOrder: Synchronous call nesting and the complete listed provider/action order; no independent pairs. Prefix stops omit unfinished returns.
